name: Navanish Pandey
title: Applied AI Engineer
tagline: Engineer with a research mindset, experienced in model development, optimization, and deployment
bio: I’m an AI/ML Engineer passionate about building real-world GenAI systems and intelligent products that solve meaningful problems. I specialize in Machine Learning, Deep Learning, and transformer-based architectures, with hands-on experience developing multi-agent AI platforms and scalable ML backends. My journey from Mechanical Engineering to Artificial Intelligence reflects strong analytical thinking and continuous learning. I enjoy turning complex AI concepts into practical applications — from custom language models to computer vision systems. Currently, I’m focused on creating impactful AI solutions at the intersection of data, automation, and innovation.
